feedback: Accepted. Format: all required headers present (STATES, INITIAL_STATE, nonempty FINAL_STATES with declared state u2), transition syntax '(state, guard) -> state' and reward syntax '(source, guard, target) -> value' are correct, and both reward entries correspond to declared transitions. Guards use only the five supplied propositions (predicate-only, no invented fluents or action names). Per-state coverage is exhaustive and deterministic: u0, u1, u2 each end with an else self-loop, so the irrelevant propositions (siren_ringing, switch_toggled) are correctly absorbed with no effect on rewards. Event/persistent distinction is used properly: box_fell (event) drives the u0->u1 edge; holding_box and at_exit (conditions) gate recovery and termination; at_exit is correctly treated as last-step-only, and the constraint pairs (box_fell/holding_box, box_fell/at_exit) mean the ordered guards in u0 and u1 never shadow each other. Semantics: the guaranteed first fall always arms u1, and the 'whenever' clause is honored because each recovery regresses u1->u0, re-arming for a second fall. A nice property of the u1 design: since (u1, !holding_box) leaves u1 after one step, the 0.2 is paid exactly when the box is recovered on the very next move after a fall, which is a compact faithful encoding of 'on your very next move' (the u1 else self-loop is effectively unreachable since holding_box & at_exit cannot co-occur, but it is harmless formal completeness). Reward safety: shaping is bounded (at most two falls, so at most 0.4) and cannot be farmed (falls are exogenous; drop does not produce box_fell), no negative rewards, terminal 1.0 paid once; progress rewards are granted at meaningful sub-goals, adequately dense for this short-horizon domain. Reachability: u1 and u2 are reachable in every episode (the first fall always fires and a post-fall pickup is always possible), and the machine is compact at three states. Two interpretation notes, not reject-worthy: (1) the terminal guard requires holding_box, which is stricter than the literal sentence (an episode that recovers from every fall, then voluntarily drops the box and exits satisfies the text but earns no terminal reward here); this is defensible because it makes the recovery clause bind - with at_exit alone an agent ignoring all falls would still collect the full terminal reward - and it matches the paired box-required setup, but if the reference allows post-recovery drops the guard should be at_exit alone. (2) Missed next-move windows are forgiven at the terminal (only the 0.2 bonus is lost), which is consistent with the soft 'try to' phrasing; a hard-failure state would be needed only if promptness were meant as a strict acceptance condition.
